fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-06-19, around 15:30, the complainant found the pocket emptied of cash (about Rs. 1,500) after boarding a crowded bus near Kurinji Puram Railway Station Road, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-06-19. Dharani Thangaraj approached Coimbatore Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000307. A person named Ganesh Shankar, associated with the number 9000000155, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Vasanth Chandran (9000000408) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Arun Babu (9000000379), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, witness, witness statement, mobile number, suspect, CCTV, afternoon
